source.origin: Current tested complete VTT runtime copy

review.note: Never refresh this hash automatically in CI. This is the complete runtime baseline; it is wrapped as a full initializer without hook or API projection.

differences.name: longRestCleanup compatibility shim
differences.summary: cleanupReversibleHitPointCapacity accepts an options object and skips the second current-hit-point adjustment when the host deletes a registered reversible-capacity effect with {longRestCleanup: true}; rebalance and ordinary expiry paths are unchanged.

differences.name: Dread Ambusher effect icon
differences.summary: The Dread Ambusher effect keeps the tested host icon path modules/arcane-dnd5e-2014-automation/Nicons/Ability_Ambush.png instead of the upstream game-icons shadow-follower.svg path.

differences.name: First-party HP pool ownership handshake
differences.summary: applyHitPointPoolAllocatorFromUse recognizes the first-party hp-pool-runtime settlement receipt (__mtHpPoolProcessed + a strictly shaped __mtHpPool). A successful receipt applies the compiler artifact exactly once to the host's affectedTokens, matching pool.affected tokenIds in order and requiring each token to be a real workflow target with an actor; it never rolls again or posts a pool card. Failed and empty receipts apply no artifact. A malformed or inconsistent receipt throws before any roll, artifact or message.

differences.name: First-party independent-projectile ownership handshake
differences.summary: applyIndependentProjectilesFromUse skips its own projectile chain only when the real workflowOptions (or usage midiOptions) carries __mtProjectileOwner, which first-party projectileCastUsage sets on the parent and every child. The runtime direct path, its child guard and receipts are unchanged.
